title: Auto-approve sessions across supported harnesses stall on tool permissions, and remaining cards show raw JSON
outcome: All supported harnesses honor active auto-approve without needless approval cards, notifications or waits; sandbox restrictions remain independent and readable, and non-auto permission cards render readable content.
acceptance: For each supported harness (Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini/agy, OpenCode, Kimi), the item records the harness's actual approval-mode setting in TermAl, how it propagates to the provider, and which tool-request classes reach TermAl as permission requests, with evidence (captured params or pinned source, and file:line).

With auto-approve active, no tool request that the mode grants produces an approval card, a notification or a wait, in any harness. That includes the Kimi Read under .git/worktrees in the session workdir. TermAl or the provider answers it according to the mode.

Sandbox stays a separate setting: its boundaries are enforced, and a request beyond a sandbox or another genuinely unmeetable constraint ends with a bounded, readable, actionable reason on the session, never a silent wait.
Any permission card that remains (non-auto modes) renders readable text, not raw JSON. The AskUserQuestion behaviour from w-65b096fb3238 is unchanged.

Behavioural tests from captured-shape fixtures per harness cover auto-approve answering, sandbox refusal with a reason, and the readable card. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary: Landed the six-harness approval-mode fixes and readable permission cards in batch commit 8577f5ec. Cursor Plan now returns a bounded actionable refusal after handing off the rejection or cancellation, and the running mode is captured once at admission. The exact landed tree passed FULL, and the independent post-landing evaluation passed all five criteria.
